summary: Spark Planner (v6_spark_planner_001) backend testing — Laag A (Brief) + Laag B (Threads) + Blueprint + Compose-integration. All 13 pytest tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: brief_builder._format_turns_for_prompt hardcodes 'Willem' as role label for ALL user-turns regardless of user_id. For test-planner-001 or any non-Willem user, the LLM is told the user is 'Willem' which may bias the brief. Consider passing user_display_name from caller or using a generic 'User'/'Gebruiker' label.

threads_service.add_or_bump_thread: when bumping, intensity sums (existing + new) up to cap of 10. POST /threads docstring says 'voeg toe of bump' but doesn't clarify additive semantics — consider documenting in route docstring.
Open threads file is global JSON without locking; concurrent writes from sync_threads_from_brief + manual CRUD could race. For backend-only test scope this is fine, but worth noting for prod.

routes.py post_run_decay accepts user_id but signature mismatches docstring expectations — when user_id=None it decays ALL users globally. Documented behavior should be made explicit (currently route name 'decay' is ambiguous).
